summary: For a convenient Chiang Mai example of grilled chicken, try Gai Yang Cherng Doi (ไก่ย่างเชิงดอย), a casual Isan-style restaurant on Suk Kasem Road in Nimman. Its signature chicken is grilled with crisp skin and tender meat, served with dipping sauce and sticky rice; order papaya salad or other dishes to share. It is a representative local venue for the dish, not an exclusively Northern Thai preparation.
whyGo: Try a recognizable grilled-chicken and sticky-rice pairing at an established Nimman restaurant.
The menu also includes papaya salad, larb and other Isan dishes, making it easy to build a shared meal.
The alley location between Nimmanhaemin Soi 2 and Soi 4 is easy to combine with a Nimman visit.
bestFor: A casual lunch or dinner with friends who want to share several dishes.
Diners who enjoy grilled chicken skin, sticky rice and sour, salty or spicy dips.
skipIf: You avoid meat, poultry, animal products or possible fish sauce and other animal-based seasonings.
You need a verified step-free route, quiet dining room or detailed allergen controls.
You want a specifically Lanna-style chicken recipe; this is an Isan-oriented grill shop.
duration: Allow about 45–75 minutes for a meal; this is a planning estimate and queues may add time.
cost: A 2026 Bangkok Biz News feature describes prices as accessible but gives no dish prices. A Wongnai listing has older menu references around ฿75 for grilled chicken and review spending of ฿101–250 per person. Budget roughly ฿150–300 per person as a planning estimate and confirm the current menu; prices may change before December 2026.
hours: A Bangkok Biz News report published in 2026 lists 11:00–20:00, closed Mondays. Wongnai currently displays closing at 22:00, while older listings also report 20:00. Hours conflict; check the restaurant's current listing or call before going, especially around holidays.
bestTime: Lunch or early dinner; arrive before peak meal times if you want to reduce the chance of a wait. December is a popular travel period, but no special December schedule is confirmed.
gettingThere: The address is 2/8 Suk Kasem Road, in Nimman between Nimmanhaemin Soi 2 and Soi 4. Walk from nearby Nimman hotels or use a local songthaew, tuk-tuk or ride-hail to the alley entrance, then walk in. A local listing says there is no dedicated parking; road parking is limited.
booking: No reservation policy was verified. Treat it as a walk-in casual restaurant; call ahead to confirm opening, wait times and group seating. Wongnai lists 081-881-1407 and 084-040-6464, but verify these numbers before relying on them.
accessibility: No reliable published accessibility information was found. It is described as a casual wooden-house restaurant reached via a small alley; ask directly about steps, accessible seating, toilets and drop-off access if these matter.
practicalTips: Order grilled chicken (ไก่ย่าง), sticky rice (ข้าวเหนียว) and papaya salad (ส้มตำ); request a lower chilli level, though the kitchen may not be able to control every seasoning.
The signature is praised for crisp skin and juicy meat. It is chicken with skin and bones; ask whether portions can be deboned if needed.
Offal is not inherent to the grilled chicken order, but this restaurant also serves organ dishes. Confirm the exact cut and preparation, and ask whether shared grills or utensils matter to you.

Chicken marinades and dipping sauces can include fish sauce, soy or other allergens, and sauces may be spicy. Ask staff about ingredients; the available sources do not establish allergen or cross-contact procedures.
Menu and pricing details in online reviews may be dated; use a current menu or ask before ordering.
decemberNotes: December is in Chiang Mai's cooler, drier season and a busy visitor period. The restaurant is indoors/open-sided by description rather than an outdoor attraction, but confirm holiday hours and expect possible crowds. No December 2026 closure or special menu has been announced in the sources checked.
uncertainties: Current hours conflict across listings; the 2026 news feature reports 11:00–20:00 and Monday closure, while Wongnai shows 22:00.
No authoritative current menu with prices, portion sizes or dietary/allergen information was found.
Booking, accessibility, payment methods and December 2026 holiday hours are unconfirmed.
